events.title: The Dead Hand demo is now available on Steam!
events.summary: The Dead Hand demo is now available on Steam! Dead Hand will also be part of Steam Next Fest from October 19 to 26. Try the demo, tell me what you think, and add the game to your wishlist if you enjoy it! Thanks for your support 🧟 — Hauteroche Studio

events.title: Alpha v0.9.20 : contrats revus, manette complète et 10 langues
events.summary: What's newFairer contracts: "The Great Escape" no longer breaks on the first HP you lose. You now get an HP budget for the whole act (60 % / 40 % / 25 % depending on difficulty), tracked on the map. Controller reviewed on every screen: soft-locks fixed, everything is reachable, buttons are consistent (B always goes back) and there are on-screen prompts. events.title: The Playtest opens its doors
events.summary: The Playtest opens its doorsAfter months of closed alpha with a small core of testers, Dead Hand is entering Public Playtest. Starting today, anyone can put in for a spot.It works like this: head to the Dead Hand Steam page and hit "Request Access".
